session.deleteBody: Its jobs can be placed again from the shelf. You can undo this.
session.stale: Laid out with old sizes · replan

archive.oldScaleHint: Printed with the old sticker size; the file comes out as printed. To use the new size, reprint and replan.

empty.noLanguage: A design language is needed first
empty.noLanguageBody: Page templates and rules belong to a design language. Create one in Settings under Design languages.
empty.noSessionBody: A shelf group's “Plan” button places the approved labels of that size onto pages automatically. Then you can move labels by hand, drag more from the shelf and produce PDF/PNG files.
empty.noTemplateBody: Set up a page template (paper and slots) first; then place the shelf's labels onto pages with Plan.

shelf.title: Shelf
shelf.empty: Nothing to print on the shelf. Labels approved in Production appear here.
shelf.noTemplate: No page template for this size
shelf.addHint: Add the remaining jobs to the open session (“{{name}}”): placed labels stay, new ones go to empty slots and new pages
shelf.markOverlap: “{{name}}”: registration marks overlap the slots. In print a mark lands on a label or the cutter cannot read it.
shelf.cutMismatch_one: No page template fits the {{size}} cut: the slots of the template without a size ({{names}}) do not match this cut. Set up a template in this size.
shelf.cutMismatch_other: No page template fits the {{size}} cut: the slots of the templates without a size ({{names}}) do not match this cut. Set up a template in this size.
shelf.cardHint: Drag onto a page · Shift: all remaining · Alt: free position · Enter: place on the active page · Quantity: {{needed}}
shelf.noSessionHint: Open a session or Plan first
shelf.dragHint: Drag · Shift all remaining · Alt free

strip.label: Desk tools
strip.noTemplates: Set up a page template first
strip.replanHint: Locked pages and hand-placed labels are kept
strip.preview: Print preview: cut lines and marks

selection.countLocked_one: {{count}} label selected ({{locked}} on a locked page)
selection.countLocked_other: {{count}} labels selected ({{locked}} on a locked page)

status.extras: Yellow corner: extra label (beyond the order)

page.name: Page name
page.lockHint: A locked page is not changed by replanning and its labels cannot be moved
page.deleteBody_one: Its {{count}} label goes back to the shelf. Undo with {{keys}}.
page.deleteBody_other: Its {{count}} labels go back to the shelf. Undo with {{keys}}.

panel.pickPage: Click a page on the canvas to set it up.

export.title: File
export.pickPage: Click a page on the canvas first; otherwise all pages are produced.
export.rasterHint: Labels as a page image (dpi); cut lines and registration marks as vectors.
export.vectorHint: Text, cut lines, registration marks and order name as vectors; the template image as raster.
export.dpiManual: set by hand · design language uses {{n}} dpi
export.pdfCopies: A page printed several times appears once in the PDF; the copy count is in the page name.
export.pngPages: Each page becomes a separate PNG.
export.markWarning: In {{names}} the registration marks reach into slots (bleed + safe area); the cutter may not read them. Change the edge inset under Page templates > Cut.
export.noEngine: The output engine is not connected yet; the server cannot produce PDF/PNG.
export.stale: Options changed; produce again for a new file.

printed.title: Mark “{{name}}” as printed?
printed.body: {{pages}} page(s) ({{sheets}} sheet(s)) move to the archive and leave the shelf. It can be found and printed again from the archive; nothing is deleted.
printed.readOnly: This session was printed ({{when}}) and is in the archive. It cannot be changed; “Print again” creates a new draft with the same pages.

toast.markOverlap: Registration marks overlap the slots in “{{name}}”; change the edge inset under Page templates > Cut.
toast.replanMissing_one: {{count}} order was not planned because it has no quantity: {{orders}}
toast.replanMissing_other: {{count}} orders were not planned because they have no quantity: {{orders}}
toast.replanned: Replanned: locked pages and hand-placed labels were kept. Undo with {{keys}}.
toast.addedPages_one: Added to the session: {{count}} new page. Undo with {{keys}}.
toast.addedPages_other: Added to the session: {{count}} new pages. Undo with {{keys}}.
toast.addedSlots: Added to the session: placed in empty slots. Undo with {{keys}}.
toast.addFailed: Could not add to the session. {{detail}}

drop.hint_one: Shift: all remaining ({{count}}) · Alt: free position
drop.hint_other: Shift: all remaining ({{count}}) · Alt: free position
drop.noPage: Drop the label onto a page.
drop.stickerOnLabel: A sticker cannot go on a label page; drop it on a sticker page.
drop.labelOnSticker: A label cannot go on a sticker page; drop it on a label page.
drop.noFreeSlot: No empty slot on this page. Drop with Alt for a free position or add a new page.
drop.short: {{added}} label(s) placed; {{short}} did not fit. Add a new page and drop the rest there.
drop.pickPage: Click a page on the canvas first; the label goes onto that page.

move.locked: Labels cannot be moved onto a locked page. Unlock the page first.

editor.conflict: This session changed elsewhere; its latest state was loaded. Your last change was not applied.

grid.invalid: Grid values are invalid: columns, rows and paper size must be positive.
grid.size: Enter the slot width and height.
grid.noFit: That many slots do not fit on this paper: reduce the columns/rows or the size.

shortcuts.adjust: Fix the selected label's text (or double-click)
shortcuts.left: Nudge left (0.1 mm; 1 mm with Shift)
shortcuts.right: Nudge right (0.1 mm; 1 mm with Shift)
shortcuts.up: Nudge up (0.1 mm; 1 mm with Shift)
shortcuts.down: Nudge down (0.1 mm; 1 mm with Shift)
shortcuts.dropAll: Hold while dropping: place all of the remaining quantity
shortcuts.dropFree: Hold while dropping: free position (no snapping to slots)

notices.plan-stale: A sticker size or a template's cut changed; this session still uses the old layout ({{sheets}} sheets). Replanning brings it to about {{replanSheets}} sheets.
notices.printed-old-scale: This session was printed with the old sticker size; the file comes out as printed.
notices.sticker-small-text: {{orderNo}}: sticker text is {{pt}} pt, limit {{minPt}} pt.
notices.exportTitle: Session laid out with the old size
notices.exportBody: Replanning first uses less paper. You can still make the file with the current layout.
